name: Hai
description: Full-size terry bath towels for homes, hotels and gifting, made in 30 × 60 and 36 × 72 inch sizes.
content:
## Bath towels made in Solapur

A bath towel is the largest towel in a set, used to dry the whole body after a bath. We manufacture terry bath towels at our unit in Solapur and supply them in bulk to wholesalers, hotels and retailers.

## Bath towel sizes

- **30 × 60 inches (76 × 152 cm), standard.** The most popular bath towel size in India. It wraps comfortably around most adults and suits homes, hotels and retail.
- **36 × 72 inches (91 × 183 cm), large.** Also called a bath sheet. Extra coverage for taller people, premium hotel rooms and gifting.

## Weight and feel

Bath towels are sold by weight per piece or by GSM (grams per square metre). Lighter towels dry faster and cost less. Heavier towels feel thick and plush. Every product page lists the weight for each size, and we can quote by weight or GSM.

## Designs and colours

We make plain, dobby border, jacquard, striped and checked bath towels in many colours. Plain and dobby-border towels in white and light colours are the favourite for hotels. Bright jacquard and striped towels sell well in retail.

## Buying bath towels in bulk

Send us the size, weight, design, colour and quantity on WhatsApp or IndiaMART and we will reply quickly with our best price. See also our [towel size guide](/towel-size-guide/) and [hotel towels guide](/hotel-towels/).

faq.q: What is the standard bath towel size?
faq.a: 30 × 60 inches (76 × 152 cm) is the standard bath towel size in India.

faq.q: What size is a large bath towel?
faq.a: 36 × 72 inches (91 × 183 cm). It is also called a bath sheet.

faq.q: Do you sell bath towels wholesale?
faq.a: Yes. We are a bath towel manufacturer and wholesaler in Solapur and supply wholesalers, hotels and retailers in bulk.

faq.q: Can I order bath towels in my own colour or weight?
faq.a: Send your size, weight, colour and quantity on WhatsApp and we will tell you what we can make.

faq.q: Where are your bath towels made?
faq.a: Our terry bath towels are made at our unit in Solapur, Maharashtra.

name: Baby Bath Towels
description: Soft, compact terry towels sized for babies and children, in 24 × 48 and 20 × 40 inch sizes.
content:
## Baby bath towels made in Solapur

Baby bath towels are smaller, lighter terry towels sized for babies and young children. They are easier to handle than full-size towels, wrap a child snugly and dry quickly between uses.

## Baby bath towel sizes

- **24 × 48 inches (61 × 122 cm).** Wraps babies and toddlers fully, and works for young children too.
- **20 × 40 inches (51 × 102 cm).** Compact and quick-drying, good for newborns and daily use.

## What to look for

Soft cotton terry is the best choice for a baby's skin. Lighter weights dry faster, which matters for towels that are washed every day. Bright stripes and printed designs are popular with parents and in gift sets.

## Buying baby towels in bulk

We supply baby bath towels to wholesalers and retailers. Send the size, design and quantity on WhatsApp or IndiaMART for a quotation.

faq.q: What size is a baby bath towel?

faq.a: Most of our baby bath towels are cotton terry. Each product page shows the material.

faq.q: Do you sell baby towels wholesale?
faq.a: Yes. Send your size, design and quantity on WhatsApp for a quotation.

name: Hand Towels
description: Everyday terry hand towels for washrooms, kitchens, salons and hospitality, in 16 × 24 and 14 × 21 inch sizes.
content:
## Hand towels made in Solapur

Hand towels are mid-size terry towels used to dry hands and face. They are needed in large numbers by hotels, restaurants, offices, salons, gyms, hospitals and homes, which makes them one of the most ordered towel types.

## Hand towel sizes

- **16 × 24 inches (41 × 61 cm).** The standard hand towel for washrooms, hotels and homes.
- **14 × 21 inches (36 × 53 cm).** Smaller and lighter, good for salons, gyms, kitchens and budget orders.

## Choosing hand towels

Hand towels are washed often, so pick a weight that dries quickly but holds up to frequent washing. Plain and dobby-border designs match easily across rooms. Bright colours suit kitchens and retail.

## Buying hand towels in bulk

We make hand towels in Solapur and supply them in bulk. Send the size, weight, colour and quantity on WhatsApp or IndiaMART for our best price. See the [towel size guide](/towel-size-guide/) for every size.

faq.q: What is the size of a hand towel?
faq.a: The standard hand towel is 16 × 24 inches (41 × 61 cm). We also make 14 × 21 inches (36 × 53 cm).

faq.q: Which hand towels are best for salons and gyms?
faq.a: The lighter 14 × 21 inch size dries quickly and keeps costs low for high-use places.

faq.q: Do you supply hand towels in bulk?
faq.a: Yes. We are a hand towel manufacturer and wholesaler in Solapur.

name: Face Towels
description: Small terry face towels and napkins, in 12 × 18 and 12 × 12 inch sizes.
content:
## Face towels made in Solapur

Face towels are the smallest towels in a set. They are used as face cloths, wash cloths and napkins, and are ordered in large quantities by hotels, restaurants, salons, hospitals and retailers.

## Face towel sizes

- **12 × 18 inches (30 × 46 cm).** A slightly larger face towel, good as a napkin or for salons.
- **12 × 12 inches (30 × 30 cm).** The classic square face cloth used in hotel room sets.

## Choosing face towels

Face towels touch the skin directly, so soft cotton terry is the usual choice. Light weights dry fast and are economical for daily use. Matching face towels with bath and hand towels in the same design makes a complete set.

## Buying face towels in bulk

Send the size, colour and quantity on WhatsApp or IndiaMART and we will quote quickly.

faq.q: What is the size of a face towel?

faq.a: Yes. A 12 × 12 inch face towel is part of the standard hotel room set.

faq.q: Can I order face towels to match bath towels?
faq.a: Yes. Many of our designs come in several sizes. Ask us for a matching set.

name: Bath Mats
description: Dense, absorbent terry bath mats in the standard 20 × 30 inch size.
content:
## Terry bath mats made in Solapur

A terry bath mat sits on the bathroom floor to catch water and keep feet dry. Bath mats are made denser and heavier than towels so they stay flat and absorb more water.

## Bath mat size

- **20 × 30 inches (51 × 76 cm).** The standard terry bath mat size for homes and hotel bathrooms.

## Choosing bath mats

Look for a dense, heavy terry that absorbs well and holds its shape after washing. Plain colours and simple borders match hotel and home bathrooms. A bath mat completes a hotel towel set with bath, hand and face towels.

## Buying bath mats in bulk

We supply terry bath mats to hotels, wholesalers and retailers. Send the colour and quantity on WhatsApp or IndiaMART for a quotation. See our [hotel towels guide](/hotel-towels/) for a full room set.

faq.q: What size is a bath mat?
faq.a: The standard terry bath mat is 20 × 30 inches (51 × 76 cm).

faq.q: Why is a bath mat heavier than a towel?
faq.a: A dense, heavy terry absorbs more water and stays flat on the floor.

faq.q: Do you supply bath mats for hotels?
faq.a: Yes. We make bath mats along with bath, hand and face towels, so the whole room set can come from us.
